errors.evidence: The red series has an intermediate point at C1 ≈0.0045 before C2 ≈0.0033; omitting C1 misstates the trajectory and the red value at C1.

The blue series at C1 is approximately 0.0044, but the description places this as a simple continuation after B2 without noting the red series value and the near-convergence at C1/C2; this is not an error by itself, so no separate factual mismatch is identified.
The description does not mention the legend entries in Chinese ('去除偏误' and '未去除偏误'), which are visible and important for identifying the two series.
The description omits that both lines are shown with distinct markers: red triangles and blue X-shaped markers, as highlighted in the figure and reference.
